messages:
Maria: quick standup — what I did: landed kernel prefetch patch (PR #482), tuned KV eviction thresholds for shard-3, ran a small perf sweep on microbatch paths.
Sam: nice, can you paste the bench numbers?
Maria: sure — did 3 runs on canary (seq_len=128, batch=16). rough p50/p95: 18ms / 85ms. token throughput ~ 3200 tps on A100-small.
Lee: those p95s still a bit high, is that KV miss-driven?
Maria: yep, mostly cold-KV misses during the first 30 steps. lowering eviction window helped ~10% on p95.
Alex: blocker: I still see occasional OOMs on a shard during stress. logs show slot allocation spikes when two heavy requests coincide.
Maria: noted — I'm going to add a soft-slot cap and instrument slot-fairness metrics today.
Sam: also pinging on your PR review — left a comment about the prefetch sampling rate default.
Maria: saw it, will update default to 0.12 and add config flag for experiments.
Alex: infra-bot just reported a canary failure earlier, linking logs: https://ci.internal/canary/482/logs
infra-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary run failed on node shard-3: OOM at step 42, autoscaler invoked, fallback to previous model variant.
Lee: low-effort followups: can we add a smoke test that simulates two concurrent long seq requests to reproduce slot spike?
Maria: yes, I'll add a smoketest in runtime/integration/smoke/slot_spike.test. sample command:
```
./tools/smoke_runner --scenario slot_spike --concurrency 2 --seq 1024
```
Maria: expected output shows a transient drop in throughput but no OOM. current canary reproduces OOM in ~30% of runs.
Sam: ok. if you tune soft-slot cap and add metric, I can shepherd a second canary later today.
Maria: plan for today: (1) add slot cap + metric, (2) update PR default + tests, (3) run 10 canary sweeps and share summary.
Alex: I'll dig into scheduler traces and see if we can reduce simultaneous allocation spikes.
Lee: I'm free to review the PR after lunch. ping me when ready.
Maria: thanks — will post an update in this thread when I have numbers. :thumbsup:
Sam: awesome, thanks team.
